1.issue: Excessively short KMS key deletion window
1.risk: A deletion_window_in_days of 7 (the minimum) provides very little time to detect and cancel an accidental or malicious key deletion. If the key is deleted, any data encrypted with it becomes permanently unrecoverable.
1.remediation: Increase 'deletion_window_in_days' to a value between 14 and 30 (e.g., 30) to provide a sufficient window to detect and cancel unintended key deletion requests.
